title: fix not rendered style when style is optional
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

fix not rendered style when style is optional, see #4527 for more info.

Resolves #4527 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

It appears that functions are considered empty object when using `isEmpty` from `lodash-es/isEmpty`, so I set the second parameter function as optional and validate it's not `undefined`.

author: Yokozuna59

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Can you change `unknown` to the proper type?
And also add it to `themes` at the top of the file?

comments.author: Yokozuna59
comments.body:
> Can you change `unknown` to the proper type?

I guess `(options?: any) => string` should be fine.

> And also add it to `themes` at the top of the file?

It would be hard with the current approach. I think we should add something like `BaseStyleOptions` that contains common options, and make other diagram extends it. I guess `fontFamily` is common as far as I know.

```diff
- const themes: Record<string, any> = {};
+ const themes: Record<string, (options?: BaseStyleOptions) => string> = {};
```

What do you think? And create `diagramTheme.ts` file would be great.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: `BaseStyleOptions` is good, but for this PR, let's stick to `unknown` or if it's too many changes, `any`.

> `BaseStyleOptions` is good, but for this PR, let's stick to `unknown` or if it's too many changes, `any`.
